scientific_question: Can a causal multiscale harmonic-censoring representation provide non-trivial evidence for fundamental attribution, source birth, harmonic false-note rejection and source cardinality after removing pitch/cutoff geometry and global-energy effects?

external_review_gate.review_summary: No structural fail-open remained after review of domains, spectral censoring, support-aware null, NNLS, cardinalities, causal state machine, replay timeline, 175 fixtures and 72 tests.

hypotheses.primary: A shared causal spectral representation observed through relative low-pass censoring contains residual structural information beyond candidate pitch and total energy.
hypotheses.source_birth: A new source is supported by a causal combination of onset, harmonic novelty, new energy and unexplained residual after accounting for older sources.
hypotheses.factorization: Global comparison of K versus K+1 sources with shared partials is safer than exclusive partial ownership or independent pitch decisions.
hypotheses.non_identifiability: Exactly coincident contributions without independent onset, envelope or harmonic evidence are not identifiable and must produce AMBIGUOUS.

mathematical_contract.shared_representation: For x[0:4096], w[n]=0.5-0.5*cos(2*pi*n/4096), X[k]=rfft(x[n]*w[n]), P[k]=abs(X[k])^2, f[k]=k*44100/4096; compute once per frame in float64.
mathematical_contract.emission_candidate_axis: physical MIDI emission candidate p in the inclusive integer range 40..76; exactly 37 rows enter the live pitch-by-censoring matrix
mathematical_contract.latent_source_axis: factorization-only source hypothesis r in integer MIDI 24..76; r<40 can explain observations but can never emit and is excluded from the 37-row live candidate matrix
mathematical_contract.virtual_observation_axis: analytical semitone coordinate q in 40..128 inclusive; q>76 is evidence-only and cannot emit MIDI
mathematical_contract.harmonic_band_energy: E(p,h)=sum_k P[k]*phi(p,h,k); harmonic_observation_valid(p,h) iff f_h(p)<=22050 and sum_k(phi(p,h,k))>0
mathematical_contract.censoring_axis: c in the exact ascending harmonic-rank grid [1,2,3,4,8,20]; hard cutoff frequency is c*F0(p); baseline is c=20
mathematical_contract.robustness_spectral_censor: M_cos(p,c,k)=1 below -12.5 cents from c*F0(p), 0 above +12.5 cents, and 0.5-0.5*sin(pi*z/2) for z in [-1,1] across that exact 25-cent interval; P_c=P*M_cos
mathematical_contract.raw_evidence: S_raw(p,c)=sum over h=1..20 with harmonic_observation_valid(p,h) of w_h*E_c(p,h,c)
mathematical_contract.normalized_evidence: S_norm(p,c)=S_raw(p,c)/B(p) iff normalization_valid; otherwise masked invalid, never zero-filled
mathematical_contract.geometric_null: Let K(p,h,c)=sum_k M(p,c,k)*phi(p,h,k)/sum_k phi(p,h,k) only when harmonic_observation_valid(p,h), else masked. S_null(p,c)=sum_valid_h w_h*K(p,h,c)/sum_valid_h w_h*K(p,h,20). This is support-aware and uses the same hard or cosine mask family as S_raw.
mathematical_contract.primary_representation: exactly 37 emission-candidate rows p=40..76 by 6 censoring columns; latent-source and observation tensors are separate

summary_definitions.k90_k50_k10: For q in {0.90,0.50,0.10}, k_q is the smallest c in [1,2,3,4,8,20] for which S_norm(p,c)>=q; null if normalization_valid is false or no crossing exists.
summary_definitions.AUC_raw: Trapezoidal integral of unnormalized S_raw(p,c) over u=log2(c), divided by log2(20)-log2(1); it retains physical power units and is not gain-invariant.
summary_definitions.AUC_normalized: Trapezoidal integral of S_norm(p,c) over u=log2(c), divided by log2(20)-log2(1); invalid when normalization_valid is false.
summary_definitions.slope: Adjacent first differences divided by adjacent log2(c) differences; maximum slope uses the lowest-c interval on ties.
summary_definitions.curvature: Second divided differences on the six ordered log2(c) coordinates.
summary_definitions.regime_change: Single index of maximum absolute curvature, lowest-c tie break; null when fewer than three valid cutoff values exist. The normative key is singular regime_change.
summary_definitions.peak_absolute_residual: max_c abs(S_residual_norm(p,c)); ties use the lowest c; invalid when normalization_valid is false.
summary_definitions.residual_at_c4: S_residual_norm(p,4); invalid when normalization_valid is false.
summary_definitions.positive_rebound: Adjacent positive increase in S_residual_norm after a prior negative decrease; retained as a diagnostic because actual spectral censoring can produce non-monotone residuals, never as a thresholded P0 decision.

replay_stream_contract.global_sample_indices: g=0..12543 inclusive; exact stream length 12544 samples
replay_stream_contract.initial_window_padding_rule: none; samples outside 0..12543 do not exist and no hop ending before 4095 is evaluated
replay_stream_contract.initial_state_rule: all latent pitches INACTIVE immediately before the first valid hop ending at g=4095; that first window is exact silence for every temporal base fixture
replay_stream_contract.new_source_global_envelope: for declared onset g0, e_new(g)=0 for g<g0; for m=g-g0>=0, min(1,(m+1)/64)*exp(-m/2048)
replay_stream_contract.fixture_relative_coordinate_rule: Any event_sample_offset a is fixture-only and maps to global onset g0=8192+a. It is never serialized to runtime state/features.
replay_stream_contract.old_source_expected_replay: old source is first proposed at hop ending 4351, enters PENDING_NEW, resolves at hop ending 4607, and is ACTIVE for every later target-hop evaluation
replay_stream_contract.base_new_source_expected_replay: base new source is first proposed at target hop ending 12287, enters PENDING_NEW, and resolves exactly at hop ending 12543
replay_stream_contract.window_extraction: For each hop end e, x[0..4095]=stream[e-4095..e] with no padding; B_prev uses the immediately preceding valid hop
replay_stream_contract.phase_continuity: All sinusoidal phase is evaluated from global g, never reset at a window boundary
replay_stream_contract.publication_requirement: Every temporal result serializes the 34 hop end samples, state transition trace and exact target/resolution hop indexes; any different pre-roll or padding fails before P0 publication.
replay_stream_contract.C02_translation_exception: C02 only appends d*256 zero-capable samples for d in [0,1,2,4], shifts both source onsets and target/resolution hops later by d hops, and uses stream length 12544+d*256; no other test may alter the base timeline.

factorization_and_source_birth_contract.cardinality_names: K_latent_pitch is the number of acoustically identifiable distinct source-pitch hypotheses in r=24..76; K_emit_pitch is the number of acoustically identifiable distinct pitches in the emission subset 40..76; K_source is physical source count and may remain AMBIGUOUS even when either pitch count is known. The name K_pitch alone is forbidden.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.observation_vector: For q=40..128, y_q=sqrt(max(sum_k P[k]*phi(q,1,k),0)) when the q,H1 kernel has support; unsupported q is masked, never zero-filled.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.dictionary: For latent source r=24..76 and observation q=40..128, A[q,r]=sum over h=1..20 of (1/h)*max(0,1-abs(100*(q-(r+12*log2(h))))/35); each column is divided by its masked L2 norm, or marked invalid if that norm is zero.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.shared_partial_rule: Predicted observation is yhat_q=sum_r A[q,r]*a_r with a_r>=0. Contributions at a collision add; no observation is exclusively assigned to one source.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.objective: For a declared hypothesis set H, choose a_H as the nonnegative minimizer of R(H)=sum_valid_q (y_q-sum_{r in H}A[q,r]*a_r)^2. If multiple minimizers exist, choose minimum L2 norm and then lexicographically smallest amplitudes in ascending r order.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.K_vs_Kplus1: Delta_R(H,r)=R(H)-R(H union {r}); improvement_valid iff Delta_R>max(1e-12,1e-10*max(R(H),1e-24)). A source is not declared born from Delta_R alone.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.temporal_inputs: Compute the same B_t(p)=S_raw_t(p,20) on the current causal 4096-sample window and B_prev(p) on the immediately preceding hop-aligned causal window; no future sample is permitted.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.causal_state_boundary: At hop t, H_old(t) is exactly the accepted active-pitch state produced after hop t-1. It is never reconstructed or edited from the overlapping current/previous spectra. A pitch already in H_old(t) is ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY and cannot receive a source-birth decision at t.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.hop_level_only: The state machine has no sample-level onset locator. Synthetic onset coordinates exist only in fixture specs/oracles and are forbidden runtime inputs. Every runtime proposal is indexed only by integer hop.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.onset_rise: O(p)=max(0,B_t(p)-B_prev(p))/max(B_t(p),1e-24) when both normalization masks are valid; otherwise masked.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.old_source_explanation: X(H_old,p)=1-Delta_R(H_old,p)/max(R(H_old),1e-24), clipped to [0,1], when R(H_old)>1e-24; if R(H_old)<=1e-24 it is 1 when Delta_R<=1e-12 and 0 otherwise.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.source_birth_tuple: T_birth(p)=(O(p),N(p),G(p),X(H_old,p),Delta_R(H_old,p),improvement_valid). H23 does not combine this tuple into a learned or weighted scalar.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.synthetic_birth_oracle: For INACTIVE p, BIRTH_SUPPORTED iff O,N,G are all valid and >1e-12, improvement_valid=true, and X<1-1e-12; NO_BIRTH iff improvement_valid=false or all of O,N,G<=1e-12; otherwise AMBIGUOUS. ACTIVE p bypasses this new-pitch rule and enters the separate retrigger rule.
factorization_and_source_birth_contract.identical_waveform_rule: If two declared latent explanations render byte-identical float64 waveforms and every allowed tuple component is identical, output AMBIGUOUS regardless of cardinality prior.

causal_temporal_state_machine.initial_state: INACTIVE for every latent pitch before replay
causal_temporal_state_machine.first_observation: At hop t, an INACTIVE pitch with a signal-derived hop-level proposal O(p)>1e-12 always moves to PENDING_NEW. No sample coordinate, ground-truth onset or samples_seen value is computed or stored; emit no NoteOn and return PENDING_NEW_AWAITING_ONE_HOP.
causal_temporal_state_machine.pending_next_hop: At exactly t+1 reevaluate the sealed synthetic_birth_oracle using the newly causal hop. BIRTH_SUPPORTED becomes ACTIVE with BIRTH_SUPPORTED_DELAYED_ONE_HOP; NO_BIRTH returns INACTIVE; AMBIGUOUS returns INACTIVE with AMBIGUOUS_REJECTED_AFTER_ONE_HOP. PENDING_NEW may never survive beyond one hop.
causal_temporal_state_machine.active_without_retrigger: If p is ACTIVE and the retrigger rule is false, remain ACTIVE and return ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY with birth=false and no new NoteOn.
causal_temporal_state_machine.retrigger_rule: For ACTIVE p, RETRIGGER_SUPPORTED iff the signal-derived hop-level O(p), N(p) and G(p) are all valid and >1e-12. No sample-level onset coordinate is estimated or input. Delta_R and improvement_valid are not used because H_old already contains p.
causal_temporal_state_machine.retrigger_transition: RETRIGGER_SUPPORTED keeps p ACTIVE, does not change K_latent_pitch, K_emit_pitch or K_source, and may emit one same-pitch NoteOn labelled retrigger. It is distinct from new-pitch BIRTH_SUPPORTED.
causal_temporal_state_machine.replay_requirement: Every temporal fixture is replayed hop-by-hop from the initial state; directly injecting H_old, ACTIVE or PENDING_NEW is forbidden.
causal_temporal_state_machine.latency_accounting: Every new-pitch birth has decision_delay_hops=1 by construction; active-history and retrigger decisions have delay 0. The pending transition uses only samples causally available at t+1, so future lookahead remains zero.

sealed_P0_numeric_contract.primary_mask_family: hard nonnegative low-pass mask M_hard(p,c,k) applied to the shared power spectrum before harmonic-band evidence
sealed_P0_numeric_contract.robustness_mask_family: raised-cosine transition in log-frequency of exactly 25 cents centred on c*F0, applied to P[k] before the same harmonic-band computation
sealed_P0_numeric_contract.ambiguous_branch_allowed_only_when: the fixture oracle is AMBIGUOUS or every explicitly named independent discriminator is exactly absent by construction

validity_mask_semantics.candidate_pitch_valid: true iff p is an integer in 40..76 for one of the 37 emission candidates; latent_source_valid is separate and true for integer r in 24..76
validity_mask_semantics.latent_source_valid: true iff r is an integer in 24..76; r<40 remains factorization-only and emission_pitch_valid=false
validity_mask_semantics.cutoff_valid: true iff c is exactly one of [1,2,3,4,8,20]
validity_mask_semantics.frequency_support_valid: true iff the requested coordinate maps to a positive frequency not above Nyquist
validity_mask_semantics.normalization_valid: the exact B(p) inequality in mathematical_contract
validity_mask_semantics.harmonic_observation_valid: true iff f_h(p)<=22050 and sum_k(phi(p,h,k))>0; only valid terms enter S_raw, S_null, residuals or factorization
validity_mask_semantics.emission_pitch_valid: true iff the output pitch is an integer in 40..76; always false for analytical coordinates 77..128
validity_mask_semantics.causal_window_valid: true iff all 4096 samples are current-or-past samples for the evaluated frame
validity_mask_semantics.onset_evidence_available: true iff the causal onset channel is present for the current hop; false is missing, not zero onset
validity_mask_semantics.old_source_context_available: true iff the causal state predates and belongs to the current stream without reset
validity_mask_semantics.virtual_observation_only: true iff analytical coordinate is in 77..128

base_cases.S1C: latent-domain diagnostic MIDI36 with H2 H3 H4 H5 decaying; factorization evidence-only below MIDI40; one source; no MIDI emission and no source birth
base_cases.S1P: physically representable MIDI40 analogue of S1C preserving harmonic ratios
base_cases.S2: true MIDI64 with its H2 H3 H4 attacked at t0; MIDI64 required; source birth present
base_cases.S3: old decaying MIDI40 around t0 and nothing new; no source birth
base_cases.S4: old decaying MIDI40 plus new true MIDI64; shared MIDI64 frequency is old H4 and new H1; two-source explanation preferred entirely inside the product domain
base_cases.S5: same shared frequency without independent onset, harmonics or envelope; exact AMBIGUOUS required

base_fixture_exact_parameters.sample_indices: global g=0..12543; target-window local n=0..4095 maps to g=8192+n
base_fixture_exact_parameters.old_envelope: the exact replay_stream_contract old_source_global_envelope with origin g=4096
base_fixture_exact_parameters.new_envelope: the exact replay_stream_contract new_source_global_envelope with base g0=12032
base_fixture_exact_parameters.storage: IEEE float32 mono WAV of all 12544 global samples at 44100 Hz plus the exact float64 full-stream array hash before cast; no peak or RMS normalization and no clipping

synthetic_OOD.impulse: x[g=12032]=0.4 and every other global sample is zero
synthetic_OOD.log_chirp: zero outside g=8192..12287; phase integral of f(n)=80*(8000/80)^(n/4095) for n=g-8192, amplitude 0.4
synthetic_OOD.pink_noise_burst: the sealed pink-noise generator gated by e_new at SNR definition relative to unit RMS

noise_generation.white: PCG64 standard_normal(12544), mean removed, divided by float64 RMS
noise_generation.pink: draw independent PCG64 standard-normal real and imaginary rfft coefficients, multiply coefficient k by 1/sqrt(max(k,1)), force DC and Nyquist imaginary parts to zero, irfft length 12544, mean remove, divide by float64 RMS
noise_generation.mixing: noise_gain=rms(clean)/(rms(noise)*10^(snr_db/20)); exact-zero clean uses rms(clean)=1 only for the OOD pink-noise-burst fixture

variant_transform_rules.amplitude_gain: multiply every source amplitude in the named base waveform by the scalar; do not change pitch, phase, envelopes or oracle category
variant_transform_rules.relative_phase_radians: add the scalar phase to harmonics h>=2 only; H1 phase remains the base phase; all other fields unchanged
variant_transform_rules.envelope_attack_decay_hops: replace e_new attack length by max(1,attack_hops*256+1) samples and decay denominator by decay_tau_hops*256 samples; onset sample remains the base 3840
variant_transform_rules.cents_inharmonicity: for every synthesized partial replace h*F0 by h*F0*2^(cents/1200)*sqrt(1+B*h^2); amplitudes, envelopes and target stay unchanged
variant_transform_rules.noise: add the exactly specified seeded unit-RMS colour at the declared SNR after clean synthesis; at 0 dB replace the categorical oracle by AMBIGUOUS_OR_OOD, otherwise preserve the base oracle
variant_transform_rules.neighbour_semitones: add one new-envelope source at base primary birth pitch plus offset, with harmonics/amplitudes identical to that birth source; add that pitch to required_pitches, increment K_latent_pitch, K_emit_pitch and K_source by one, and set its birth supported
variant_transform_rules.interval_semitones: add one old-envelope source at the first source pitch plus interval, with harmonics 1..4 and base amplitudes; add its pitch to required_pitches and increment identifiable K_latent_pitch/K_emit_pitch/K_source by one
variant_transform_rules.chord_spec: replace S2's single MIDI64 source by simultaneous new-envelope sources at 64 plus each declared chord offset; each uses harmonics 1..4 and base amplitudes; required_pitches is that exact sorted set and K_latent_pitch=K_emit_pitch=K_source=set size
variant_transform_rules.physical_unison: add a second MIDI64 waveform component using the declared gain, phase and envelope; K_latent_pitch=K_emit_pitch=1 and K_source=AMBIGUOUS for both variants because the sealed factorization has one column per pitch and cannot represent two physical instances at the same pitch. The distinct variant is retained only to verify temporal evidence is preserved without claiming source count.
variant_transform_rules.technique: apply the named continuous instantaneous-frequency trajectory to S2 MIDI64 H1..H4 over the declared hop count, preserving harmonic ratios, source identity and K_source=1; no intermediate semitone birth is allowed
variant_transform_rules.natural_harmonic: replace S1P retained harmonics and H1 amplitude exactly by named_variant_value_contract.natural_harmonic; K_latent_pitch=K_emit_pitch=1 and source identity may be NATURAL_HARMONIC_OR_UNKNOWN, never an added MIDI birth
variant_transform_rules.sympathetic_resonance: for every global g=0..12543 add to S3 a MIDI64 H1 sinusoid multiplied by the declared relative amplitude and the exact old-source global envelope e_old(g), with the same global origin g=4096, continuous global phase and no separate onset or own harmonics; K_source and birth are AMBIGUOUS_OR_RESONANCE, never BIRTH_SUPPORTED
variant_transform_rules.old_source_age_hops: keep the old onset fixed at global g=4096 and replace its envelope for g>=4096 by exp(-((g-4096)+age_hops*256)/8192); samples g<4096 remain exact zero, replay schedule and targets unchanged
variant_transform_rules.event_sample_offset: Fixture-only waveform transform: replace new_onset_sample by the declared current-window index, then replay hop-by-hop from INACTIVE without exposing that coordinate to the runtime. At the target hop offsets 0,1,255,256 have already completed pending resolution and yield ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY; offsets 3840 and 4095 are first proposed at that hop and both yield PENDING_NEW_AWAITING_ONE_HOP, then BIRTH_SUPPORTED_DELAYED_ONE_HOP at t+1 for sealed S2/S4. The coordinate and available sample count are oracle diagnostics only, absent from features/state.
variant_transform_rules.pitch_boundary: for 40 or 76 replace S2 source/candidate pitch 64 by that MIDI pitch and preserve harmonics/oracle; for analytical_128 keep the S2 waveform unchanged, evaluate only q=128 H1 observation validity/firewall, create no source/candidate at 128 and require emission_pitch_valid=false
variant_transform_rules.silence: replace the complete global stream by exactly 12544 float64 zeros, replay the same 34 hop ends, and set oracle SILENCE_UNEXPLAINED with every normalization_valid=false
variant_transform_rules.synthetic_OOD: replace the complete S2 waveform by the exact named OOD waveform; remove source/required_pitches targets and set oracle OOD_OR_UNEXPLAINED

closed_variant_manifest.id_rule: <base_id>__<axis>__<value_tokens_in_declared_order>; tokens use the exact JSON scalar spellings with dot replaced by p and minus by m
closed_variant_manifest.combination_policy: one_factor_at_a_time_only; no undeclared Cartesian cross-axis combinations
closed_variant_manifest.variant_transform_rule_key_invariant: sorted(keys(variant_transform_rules)) == sorted(unique axis values in variant_families); exact expected key count=17
closed_variant_manifest.manifest_materialization: A zero-science generator must materialize the exact IDs/specs and SHA-256 before any fixture waveform is synthesized.

reproducibility_seal.fixture_seed_derivation: seed is the unsigned little-endian uint64 represented by the first 8 bytes of SHA256(UTF8('H23|' + fixture_id))
reproducibility_seal.same_runtime_replay_requirement: resolved contracts, float64 arrays before WAV cast, WAV bytes and JSON reports must be byte-identical
reproducibility_seal.cross_runtime_requirement: categories and masks exact; float64 values rtol=1e-10 atol=1e-12; byte identity is not claimed

test_record_resolution.rule: Every catalogue entry inherits every missing field below; an explicit per-test field overrides the inherited value.
test_record_resolution.phase_resolution: The phase field is the enclosing test_catalogue key for that entry.

inherited_defaults.fail_rule: Any violation of the explicit oracle/pass_rule, any nonfinite unmasked value, any missing required artifact, inverse_expected_failure_observed != true, or inverse_unexpectedly_passes_primary_oracle == true is FAIL.
inherited_defaults.drawback: Record the strongest alternative explanation, any dependence on pitch/gain/filter/window geometry, and whether the test can only demonstrate a necessary rather than sufficient condition.

inverse_check_polarity.inverse_expected_failure_observed_true: inverse check passes and does not fail the primary test

P0_analytic.oracle: all edges are low_to_high and C4 never explains C3
P0_analytic.inverse_check: inject one descending edge and require failure

P0_analytic.exact_input: ideal continuous frequency scaling factors 2^(s/12), s in [-24,-12,-1,0,1,12,24], and the exact six relative cutoffs
P0_analytic.procedure: derive transformed cutoff on the original spectrum
P0_analytic.oracle: analytic equality under ideal scaling; sampled float64 check uses rtol=1e-10 and atol=1e-12
P0_analytic.pass_rule: symbolic equality and every sampled comparison within the sealed tolerance
P0_analytic.inverse_check: the exact raised-cosine robustness mask must be labelled an approximation, not analytic equality

P0_analytic.procedure: predict disappearance using pitch and cutoff only
P0_analytic.inverse_check: shuffle waveform while preserving pitch/cutoff geometry

P0_analytic.exact_input: two latent explanations rendering identical waveform

P0_analytic.objective: separate latent pitch emission pitch and physical sources
P0_analytic.exact_input: S1C, one emit-capable source and two strings at the same MIDI with identical waveform
P0_analytic.oracle: S1C has K_latent_pitch=1/K_emit_pitch=0; emit-capable single pitch has 1/1; identical unison has K_latent_pitch=K_emit_pitch=1 while K_source is AMBIGUOUS
P0_analytic.pass_rule: no K_pitch alias and no false K_source certainty
P0_analytic.inverse_check: force K_source or collapse the two pitch cardinalities and require failure

P0_analytic.exact_input: 37 emission candidates 40..76, 53 latent source hypotheses 24..76 and 89 observation coordinates 40..128
P0_analytic.procedure: enumerate all three distinct domains and verify 76+12*log2(20)=127.86313713864834 is covered
P0_analytic.oracle: exact counts 37/53/89; latent 24..39 and observations 77..128 are evidence-only; no coordinate 129
P0_analytic.inverse_check: treating latent MIDI36 or observation 128 as emit-capable must fail

P0_analytic.exact_input: same harmonic geometry at multiple F0
P0_analytic.procedure: express cutoffs as cutoff_over_F0 and harmonic rank
P0_analytic.pass_rule: directionally identical masks modulo supported bins
P0_analytic.inverse_check: absolute-only cutoff must expose pitch bias

P0_analytic.procedure: enumerate sample support for frame t
P0_analytic.oracle: no sample after current causal boundary

P0_DSP.exact_input: each of the six base waveforms, candidates 40..76 and cutoffs [1,2,3,4,8,20]
P0_DSP.procedure: compare vectorized and scalar float64 references
P0_DSP.oracle: same raw normalized null and residual curves
P0_DSP.inverse_check: permute mask storage and recover canonical outputs

P0_DSP.oracle: raw scales and normalized structure is invariant when defined
P0_DSP.inverse_check: zero-energy case must be invalid not negative

P0_DSP.exact_input: for each p=40..76 set P[k] so every nonempty harmonic kernel has equal unit projected energy and every empty kernel is masked
P0_DSP.procedure: apply each actual spectral mask and its sealed K(p,h,c) null
P0_DSP.oracle: S_residual_norm=0 and S_residual_raw=0 for every supported p/c; unsupported terms never enter either sum
P0_DSP.pass_rule: absolute error <=1e-12 and validity bits exact
P0_DSP.inverse_check: force one empty kernel into the denominator and require failure

P0_DSP.exact_input: candidate p=40 with two explicitly synthesized shared spectra: A has equal projected energy in H1..H5 and B has the same total projected energy concentrated in H1; same p and six real spectral masks
P0_DSP.procedure: compute sealed P_c, raw, normalized, support-aware null and residual curves
P0_DSP.oracle: the curves differ at at least one of c=1,2,3,4 by more than 1e-12 while pitch is identical
P0_DSP.pass_rule: scalar/vector parity and each declared nontrivial difference exact within tolerance
P0_DSP.inverse_check: a pitch-only proxy produces identical A/B outputs and must fail

P0_DSP.exact_input: the sealed hard spectral mask and the sealed 25-cent raised-cosine robustness mask on S1C S1P S2 S3 S4 S5
P0_DSP.procedure: repeat every core oracle with both families and the same hop-level state machine
P0_DSP.oracle: S1C/S1P remain no new birth, S3 remains ALREADY_ACTIVE_HISTORY, S2/S4 remain BIRTH_SUPPORTED_DELAYED_ONE_HOP, S5 remains AMBIGUOUS
P0_DSP.pass_rule: all six categorical oracles and delays exact under both families
P0_DSP.inverse_check: a deliberately shifted 200-cent cutoff must break at least one curve comparison and be detected

P0_DSP.exact_input: S1P and S4 at phases [0,pi/2,pi,3pi/2] from the sealed numeric contract
P0_DSP.procedure: repeat all evidence and categorical oracles
P0_DSP.oracle: S1P remains one-source/no-birth and S4 remains two-source/birth for every phase; S5 remains AMBIGUOUS
P0_DSP.pass_rule: all categorical oracles exact; numeric comparisons use sealed tolerance
P0_DSP.inverse_check: a phase label supplied without waveform change must have no effect

P0_DSP.objective: window boundary state-machine semantics without onset-coordinate leakage
P0_DSP.exact_input: event_sample_offset fixture variants [0,1,255,256,3840,4095] replayed hop-by-hop from INACTIVE
P0_DSP.procedure: run the hop-level INACTIVE/PENDING_NEW/ACTIVE machine, retain every transition, and assert runtime schema contains neither onset_coordinate nor samples_seen
